ngaap.guidance: Q1-15: adjusted diluted EPS $0.90-$0.94 (GAAP $0.76-$0.80 + Nobel inventory step-up $0.02 + amortization $111m pretax / $0.12). FY2015: adjusted diluted EPS $4.30-$4.40 (GAAP $3.81-$3.91 + Nobel inventory step-up $22m pretax / $0.02 + amortization of acquisition-related intangibles $441m pretax, $337m after-tax / $0.47); core revenue growth 3%-4%; stronger US dollar expected to reduce 2015 EPS ~$0.10, ~$0.05 of which offset by Q4-14 productivity actions, recent acquisitions and other actions.

Definition change announced: from 2015 guidance, adjusted EPS also excludes amortization of acquisition-related intangibles. No FCF table in the release.
